name: Solenne Filament Collar — Data Weave Edition
description: A structured choker-width necklace of interlaced biophotonic filaments in deep violet and gold, appearing to shift color under different lighting conditions. Worn flush to the throat, it doubles as a passive data-storage device — the weave pattern encodes up to 2TB of encrypted information readable only by a matched Solenne reader ring. Constructed from lab-grown silk analogs over a flexible titanium-alloy micro-frame. Clasp is a subtle magnetic lock disguised as a sculptural node.
functionality: Passive 2TB encrypted data storage in weave pattern. Requires matched reader ring to decode. Biophotonic filaments shift spectrum under UV — doubles as a visual authentication marker at Spire-tier access points.
what_it_says: Beautiful, dangerous, and carrying something important that only one other person in the room can read.
story_hooks: A Solenne collar pulled from an unidentified body at the base of the Spire contains data that was supposedly destroyed in a corponation server purge two years prior.
The matched reader ring for this collar is registered to a person who has been officially listed as deceased for eighteen months.
Counterfeit versions have flooded the Tier 3 market — identical in appearance but storing nothing, the weave pattern a hollow imitation.

physical_description.visual_profile: A luminous choker that hugs the throat like liquid starlight—deep violet filaments interlaced with gold threads create an iridescent, almost living appearance. The weave shifts from cool violet to warm amber as light moves across it, commanding attention without screaming for it. Sits flush against the skin, evoking both luxury and subtle technological sophistication.
physical_description.fit: Snug choker fit, conforming precisely to the throat without restriction. The flexible titanium-alloy micro-frame allows for slight give and movement while maintaining structural integrity. Designed for skin-contact wear.
physical_description.primary_material: Lab-grown silk analogs over flexible titanium-alloy micro-frame; biophotonic filaments (violet and gold)
physical_description.texture: Smooth and slightly cool to the touch with a subtle luminescence. The silk analogs have a luxe, almost organic sheen; the filaments themselves feel delicate but possess hidden structural strength. Appears almost liquid in motion.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep violet (dominant) interlaced with burnished gold; iridescent shift between cool and warm tones under variable lighting. No visible wear or discoloration on pristine units.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic lock disguised as a sculptural node; seamless and invisible when fastened
distinctive_features: Biophotonic filaments that shift color under different lighting angles
Weave pattern encodes 2TB encrypted data storage
Requires matched Solenne reader ring for data access
Micro-textured sculptural clasp node (magnetic, not traditional)
Visible data architecture—the weave IS the function
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury; prohibitively expensive for working-class use
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corpo elites, data brokers, and high-tier networked individuals. Signals wealth, access to proprietary biotech, and integration into encrypted information ecosystems. A status symbol masquerading as jewelry.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine on purchase; may develop subtle micro-fractures in filaments with heavy daily wear, though the core function remains intact. Rarely seen weathered or patched—owners replace rather than repair.
